questions.question: 1.What is the main role of Agrobacterium in plant genetic transformation?

answers.a: To act as a nutrient source for plants
answers.b: To naturally insert T-DNA into plant cells
answers.c: To create resistant genes within plants

questions.question: 2.Which material is commonly used for microcarrier particles in particle bombardment?
3.What does acetosyringone do in Agrobacterium-mediated transformation?

answers.d: Acts as a nutrient source for the plant

questions.question: 4.What is the primary advantage of particle bombardment over Agrobacterium-mediated transformation?

answers.b: It can be used for a wider range of plant species

questions.question: 5.What stops the macrocarrier before particles reach the target cells in particle bombardment?
6.Which Agrobacterium strain is commonly used for genetic transformation?
7.In Agrobacterium-mediated transformation, why are plant cells co-cultivated in the dark?

answers.b: To minimize cell damage from light exposure
answers.c: To improve transformation efficiency by affecting hormone levels

questions.question: 8.How is the genetic material delivered into plant cells during particle bombardment?

answers.c: By a high-pressure blast of helium gas
